description: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for different language families across several model and regularization configurations. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, and “Uralic”, presented in this order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there are six grouped bars representing different model-regularization combinations: light green “mBERT-L2”, light blue “XLM-L2”, yellow “mBERT-R2”, dark red “XLM-R2”, green “mBERT-B2”, and dark blue “XLM-B2”. Within each group, the bars are arranged in the order listed in the legend. Each bar displays an error bar extending vertically from the top, indicating variability. The shortest bars are generally found for the “Isolate” language family, with values around 1-3 for most models, while the tallest bars are observed for the “IE-Indic” family, reaching approximately 31 for “XLM-R2”. All bars are consistently colored according to their model-regularization combination, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
